fields.reasoning: m2-interviews-recorded promises that interview answers are recorded as Decisions automatically, with picked options as the agent's wording and only typed text quoted as the owner's. The change set fixes exactly two failures of that promise: session done writing duplicate answer-<session>-N Decisions for picks the planner already recorded, and owner wording applied to proxy answers. The code under repair (session done's answer capture, leaf done-captures-answers) is that done point's lineage, so no new intent is needed. The apply-latency note in the intention points at a separate daemon CPU bug and does not change which intent this fix serves.
fields.statement: Change set 'Fix Plan interviews duplicate' serves the landed done point m2-interviews-recorded.
